title: MoD, social justice ministry ink MoU to boost welfare of senior citizens
description:
The Ministry of Defence and the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment on Monday joined hands for the establishment of new day care centres and senior citizen homes in cantonments under Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY).
A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was inked in the presence of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar in New Delhi.
The MoU also envisages skill training of geriatric caregivers, the defence ministry said.
Under the proposed arrangement, the social justice ministry will extend financial assistance under AVYAY, including support towards the operation and maintenance of existing day care centres and senior citizen homes run by cantonment boards from their own budgets, it said in a statement.
